svg.title: Flower and season replacement
svg.desc: Step 1: you find a flower or season tile in your hand. Step 2: place it face up in front of you; it is a bonus, not part of your hand. Step 3: draw a replacement tile from the end of the wall. Repeat if the replacement is another bonus tile.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: Bonus tiles are set aside and replaced

svg.text: Repeat if the new tile is also a flower or season.
